notice.title: Notification for Pharmacist – SC & ST Shortfall Vacancies

registration_deadline.evidence: Last date for submission of Application (Online Registration & Online payment)

payment_deadline.evidence: Last date for offline payment of fee through Indian Bank

fees.raw: Fee: Rs.300/- The details regarding on-line/off-line remittance can be seen in Annexure-1

pay.evidence: Scale of pay of Rs Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 (Pay Matrix Level-11)

The selected candidates will be paid scale of pay of Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 i) Successful candidate shall join duty within 30 days the date of receipt of appointment order and shall not claim extension of joining time citing that he/she is undergoing higher studies or for any other reason

clauses.text: Minimum Age (should have completed) ( in years) Maximum Age (in years) 18 57
Must have registered with Tamil Nadu Pharmacy Council and must keep the registration alive by renewing it regularly every year
Minimum educational qualification required for the post Weightage of marks Diploma Course HSC / P.U.C SSLC / 10th Diploma in Pharmacy 50% 30% 20%

ii) Wherever the basic essential qualification for a technical post is a Diploma and admission to such a programme been changed from SSLC to HSC, in all such cases the weightage will be restricted to marks obtained in SSLC and the technical Diploma
Evidence and Mark sheet of Educational qualification (SSLC / HSC / Diploma Course in Pharmacy)
